title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11465)
clause_1_scope: 1. Scope — This standard applies to single acting trunk type piston reciprocating air compressors for the general purpose industrial applications having horse power up to 25 kW meant for intermittent duty (2 000 operating hours per year) applications.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
